item.title: Patch now: Critical vulnerabilities in Synology DiskStation Manager (DMS) enabling unauthorized data disclosure or denial-of-service (DoS)
item.description:
Synology DiskStation Manager (DMS): Denial of service · CCB warning · fix available · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the security update for Synology DiskStation Manager (DMS). The CCB advisory lists the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix.

Critical · Fix available
